research_scope: Compare products that let SaaS and AI-agent builders give their end users connections to third-party apps: managed OAuth and token refresh, per-user (multi-tenant) connections, actions callable from code or as agent tools/MCP, triggers and webhooks, embeddable branded connect UI, custom connectors, monitoring, setup via coding agents, app-count claims, public pricing model and starting price, compliance badges and customer proof. Look first at each vendor's homepage hero, pricing page, docs (auth, white-label, MCP) and changelog; use search results only to find pages, and mark search-only facts. Record URL and date for every fact, quote at most 15 words, and treat missing public evidence as 'not found on public pages'. Generic substitutes (build in-house, spreadsheets/manual, doing nothing) are tracked in docs/COMPETITORS.md, not here.

competitors.name: Composio
competitors.overlap: Per-user managed auth, agent tools, MCP and triggers for developers building AI apps and agents.
competitors.notes: Pro $29/mo; 1,500+ apps claimed. May 2026 security incident documented by Composio; do not use in copy.

competitors.name: Pipedream Connect
competitors.overlap: Managed end-user auth, actions, triggers and MCP for apps and agents; hero line nearly identical to viaSocket's.
competitors.notes: Bills $2/external user/mo after 100. Workflows product shuts down 2027-03-31; Connect continues. Workday ownership per press/SEC, not on site.

competitors.name: Nango
competitors.overlap: Code-first integration infrastructure (auth, actions, syncs, MCP) for SaaS products and AI agents.
competitors.notes: Agent-led onboarding (paste prompt into coding agent) since 2026-06-01. Open source; branding needs $450/mo add-on.

competitors.name: Paragon
competitors.overlap: Embedded Connect Portal for end-user auth plus ActionKit actions/MCP for AI agents and SaaS products.
competitors.notes: No public price; action counts conflict (1000+/300+/130+). Existing site tables cite unsourced Paragon values.

competitors.name: Prismatic
competitors.overlap: Embedded iPaaS for B2B SaaS whose built flows are exposed to AI agents via MCP.
competitors.notes: 190+ connectors; per-instance pricing not public. Site table's '~$500/mo, no free tier' is unsupported.

competitors.name: StackOne
competitors.overlap: AI agent integration platform with per-user linked accounts, MCP per connector and a white-label OEM plan.
competitors.notes: 570+ connectors, 35,000+ actions. Leads on agent security (prompt-injection guard, PII redaction).

competitors.name: Membrane (formerly Integration.app)
competitors.overlap: Per-tenant connections, actions and events for products and agents, with AI-generated connectors.
competitors.notes: integration.app 301-redirects here. Claims 100,000+ integrations. Pricing page rendered empty; figures from Jan 2026 article.

competitors.name: Albato Embedded
competitors.overlap: White-label integrations and embeddable AI agents inside SaaS products, sold to SaaS companies.
competitors.notes: From $3,000/mo, sales-led, 4-8 week rollout. No public changelog found.

competitors.name: Arcade.dev
competitors.overlap: Per-user OAuth agent tools and MCP runtime, positioned as enterprise governance for agent actions.
competitors.notes: Triggers and white-label connect UI not found on public pages. Team $25/mo + usage.

competitors.name: Cyclr
competitors.overlap: Embedded iPaaS marketplace where SaaS end users connect apps, plus MCP PaaS.
competitors.notes: 600+ connectors; from $1,595/mo.

competitors.name: Zapier (MCP / Embedded MCP / Powered by Zapier)
competitors.overlap: Pitches 'your product or AI agent' with embedded per-user MCP, but embed routes depend on Zapier accounts and an App Directory listing.
competitors.notes: 9,000+ apps; MCP call = 2 tasks; embed pricing not public. AI Actions deprecation seen only in search/community.

competitors.name: Merge (Unified API + Agent Handler)
competitors.overlap: Unified API with normalised data models; Agent Handler offers per-user MCP tools to agent builders.
competitors.notes: Launch $650/mo for 10 linked accounts; Agent Handler Pro $1,000/mo.

competitors.name: Unified.to
competitors.overlap: Real-time unified API with embedded auth and per-connection MCP for B2B SaaS and agents.
competitors.notes: From $750/mo; no free tier.

competitors.name: Workato Embedded
competitors.overlap: Enterprise embedded iPaaS that SaaS companies white-label for their customers.
competitors.notes: Pricing not public; trust center did not load.

competitors.name: Tray Embedded (Tray.ai)
competitors.overlap: Enterprise platform with an embedded use case: build once, each customer connects own accounts under your brand.
competitors.notes: 700+ connectors; tiers sales-only.

competitors.name: Make
competitors.overlap: End users automate across apps themselves; MCP exposes the owner's scenarios, OEM white-label only in developer docs.
competitors.notes: Paid prices did not render on 2026-10-23; not verified.

competitors.name: n8n
competitors.overlap: Self-hostable automation used by teams themselves or as a hidden backend; OEM embed requires n8n branding.
competitors.notes: Embed pricing not public (~$50K/yr per third parties, unverified).

competitors.name: Activepieces Embed
competitors.overlap: Embedded white-label flow builder with customer connections via API or connect dialog.
competitors.notes: Scan only (2026-10-23). Sales-only yearly contract; 770+ pieces, MCP, self-host on main site. Deep-dive next cycle.

competitors.name: Truto
competitors.overlap: Integration platform for AI with 900+ integrations, each exposable as an MCP server.
competitors.notes: Scan only. No public pricing; 30-day sandbox.

competitors.name: Ampersand
competitors.overlap: Integration infrastructure for enterprise products with embeddable setup and per-tenant credentials.
competitors.notes: Scan only. withampersand.com redirects here. No count, pricing or MCP on homepage.

competitors.name: Alloy Automation
competitors.overlap: Site navigation lists MCP, Embedded iPaaS and a Connectivity API.
competitors.notes: Scan only. /mcp 404 and /embedded-ipaas empty on 2026-10-23; re-check.

competitors.name: Boomi Embedded
competitors.overlap: Enterprise native integrations inside your product, embeddable or headless UI.
competitors.notes: Scan only. Enterprise, pricing not public.

competitors.name: Klavis AI
competitors.overlap: Docs describe per-user managed OAuth MCP servers with a white-label API; homepage now pitches agent training environments.
competitors.notes: Possible pivot; re-check overlap.

competitors.name: Apideck
competitors.overlap: Unified API (now accounting-focused, 55+ systems) with embeddable white-label connect UI.
competitors.notes: Unified-API substitute type; no MCP found.

competitors.name: Hotglue
competitors.overlap: Embedded data-sync integrations with white-label widget, 600+ connectors.
competitors.notes: Data sync, not actions/agents.

competitors.name: Smithery
competitors.overlap: MCP registry handling OAuth/credentials for agent builders.
competitors.notes: Banner says MCP Proxy and managed identity shut down on Oct 31 (year not stated); likely to drop.

competitors.name: Integrately Embed
competitors.overlap: Widget lets SaaS users run the vendor's pre-built automations.
competitors.notes: Dropped: only pre-built automations, no per-user action layer or agent tools found.

competitors.name: MuleSoft
competitors.overlap: Internal enterprise iPaaS for connecting a company's own systems.
competitors.notes: Dropped: no embedded/OEM product found in search.

competitors.name: Pabbly Connect
competitors.overlap: End-user automation tool.
competitors.notes: Dropped: no embed or white-label offer found in search.
